plan.title: Scholarship Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Overview of applicant status, performance, and demographics

panels.title: Total applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Approved applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Approved'

panels.title: Average marks
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Average family income
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Family Income") AS avg_income FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applicants by taluka
panels.sql: SELECT "Taluka", COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Status distribution
panels.sql: SELECT Status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average marks by category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Income by category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", AVG("Family Income") AS avg_income FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 talukas by applicants
panels.sql: SELECT "Taluka", COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows {{p1}} total scholarship applications, with {{p2}} approved so far. Average marks across all applicants are {{p3}}%, while average family income is {{p4}}₹. The most active talukas are highlighted in p5, with {{p5.n}} being the highest. Status distribution in p6 reveals {{p6.n}} pending applications require attention. Mark trends by category in p7 show {{p7.n}} has the highest performance, while income disparities in p8 highlight {{p8.n}} as the highest-earning group. The table in p9 lists the top 10 talukas with the most applicants.
